div.div: The empty array means the effect runs in render 1 and never again, so the callback keeps render 1's count = 0. It sets 1, then 1, then 1 forever.

div.div: The updater form asks React for the latest value instead of remembering one. A ref works too, but it is invisible to rendering — use it only when the value is not displayed.

div.div: A stale closure is never a React bug — it is JavaScript working correctly. The dependency array is the list of captured values you promise are still current.
